title: Retreat gooto oo
intro: E nder annal moƴƴere Alla, ina woodi ruuhu laaɓɗo mo alaa ko nanndi e mum, seertuɗo e leñol mum ngam ɗaɓɓude solitude e laawol ceningol. Ɓe nganndaano wonde ndee ɗoo seertude ina addana adunaaji ɗii fof maande, jarribo gooŋɗinal kaaleteengal haa abada.
clues: Miɗo halfinaa nguurndam gollal hade am jibineede.
Mi waɗtaa e les njiimaandi annabi tedduɗo.
Mi duminaama e ballal ummoraade e Alla haawnii gardinooɗo am.
Mi woppii ɓesngu am, mi yahi to nokku fuɗnaange.
Maleyka gooto feeñii e am e mbaadi neɗɗo timmuɗo, ina addana mi kabaaru ɓiɗɗo laaɓɗo.
Nde ngartu-mi e ɓiɗɗo am keso oo, leñol am tuumi mi, kono cukalel ngel haali ngam daɗndude mi.

trial.answer: Kaawis jibingol e jibineede ɓiɗɗo gorko

outcome.answer: Cukalel ngel haali ngam faddaade yumma

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
